scope: Prepare the Chrome Web Store connection.

topics.title: Chrome Web Store preparation
details: The desktop app now accepts the assigned Chrome Web Store extension identity as well as the existing development extension.
The store listing is still a draft. Store installation and automatic setup are not available yet. Continue using the current browser extension until the store release is approved.
Your existing browser connection, menus and controls continue to use the same browser engine.

topics.title: Keep existing connections available
details: The native host accepts only the existing development identity and the assigned Chrome Web Store identity. Existing users can keep their current extension while the store version is prepared.
The installer checks both approved extension identities during its Windows validation.
